name: dental-clinic
description: Dental OS — Multi-tenant clinic management system

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix "dental os" && npm install --prefix dashboard
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix "dental os" && npm run build --prefix dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app,admin -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix \"dental os\"" "npm run dev --prefix dashboard"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix "dental os" && npm run lint --prefix dashboard
scripts.audit:all: npm audit --prefix server; npm audit --prefix "dental os"; npm audit --prefix dashboard
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build:all
